subject.title: Remote gateway node pairing broken — node token scopes empty, approval flow incomplete

question: Should the remaining remote node-token scope and approval failures be fixed in this Windows client, the gateway/CLI, or both before this issue can close?
rationale: The unresolved symptoms affect role-scoped credentials and approval boundaries for remote command execution, and current evidence says the client hardening is partial while external gateway behavior remains unproven.

options.title: Keep focused auth review open
options.body: Keep this issue open and require current-main remote gateway proof plus a maintainer-owned decision on node token scopes, node-role rotation, and pending approval ownership.

options.title: Move remaining gateway-only work
options.body: If maintainers confirm the Windows client now behaves correctly, leave a comment linking the canonical gateway-side issue and close only after that handoff is explicit.

options.title: Close under the umbrella tracker
options.body: Close this only if the umbrella tracker is accepted as the sole place for the specific token-scope evidence and no focused Windows-node follow-up is desired.

recommendation.title: Keep focused auth review open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require current-main remote gateway proof plus a maintainer-owned decision on node token scopes, node-role rotation, and pending approval ownership.
